Migration.Name: Add support for fractional years of useful life in FA
Migration.Comments: https://github.com/adempiere/adempiere/issues/4412 MUST RUN AFTER 10590: the loader sorts the directory by file name (MigrationFromXML:59), not by SeqNo, so this file is numbered 10595. 10590 installs the altercolumn() body and the public.deps_* helpers this migration needs. No INSERT INTO t_alter_column and no hand-written ALTER TABLE steps: MMigrationStep calls MColumn.syncDatabase() on a changed AD_Column (MMigrationStep:620), whatever DATABASE_AUTO_SYNC says, and that sync feeds the t_alter_column rule. In a full migration run the sync is queued and performed by MMigration.syncColumn at the end of the run instead of per column. ROLLING THIS BACK NARROWS THE COLUMNS (MMigrationStep:746) and PostgreSQL ROUNDS on narrowing, so a stored 3.3333 comes back as 3. The dictionary is left at 22/29.

Step.Comments: Install the altercolumn() that the t_alter_column rule calls, from db/ddlutils/postgresql/functions/altercolumn.sql, so an installed database gets the same body a new database gets.
